tooltip.infinitygauntlet.gauntlet.hint: Right-click a stone onto the gauntlet to install it (empty cursor removes one). Use to cast; V/C cycles abilities, G cycles stones, hold R for the wheel.
tooltip.infinitygauntlet.stone.space: Housed in the Tesseract. Bends space itself.
tooltip.infinitygauntlet.stone.mind: Telekinesis and dominion over minds. Signature finisher: Psychic Overload. Combined with Space it powers the Consciousness Nexus.
tooltip.infinitygauntlet.stone.reality: Rewrites matter and perception. Signature finisher: Reality Rewrite. (Its other abilities awaken in a future update)
tooltip.infinitygauntlet.stone.power: Raw cosmic destruction: beams, meteors, singularities and planet-breaking blows.
tooltip.infinitygauntlet.stone.time: Housed in the Eye of Agamotto. Freezes, slows, accelerates and rewinds time.
tooltip.infinitygauntlet.stone.soul: Life, spirit and spectral guardians. Signature finisher: Soul Extraction. (Its other abilities awaken in a future update)
tooltip.infinitygauntlet.stone.install: Right-click it onto an Infinity Gauntlet in your inventory, or sneak-use the gauntlet with the stone in your off hand.
screen.infinitygauntlet.wheel.hint: Inner ring: stone · Outer ring: ability · Release to select
message.infinitygauntlet.no_stones: The gauntlet is empty. Install an Infinity Stone first.
message.infinitygauntlet.stone_dormant: The %s Stone's power has not awakened yet.
message.infinitygauntlet.portal.anchored: Rupture anchored. Cast again anywhere to open its twin.
message.infinitygauntlet.portal.cross_di: Cross-dimension ruptures are disabled on this server.
message.infinitygauntlet.swap.anchored: %s anchored. Cast at another target (or at nothing) to swap.
message.infinitygauntlet.swap.no_target: Aim at a creature, or sneak-cast to place a marker.
message.infinitygauntlet.gateway.no_sky: Not enough open sky above the target.
message.infinitygauntlet.prison.sealed: %s is sealed in a spatial prison.
message.infinitygauntlet.waypoint.invali: The waypoint's dimension no longer exists.
ability.infinitygauntlet.dimensional_por: Open a dimensional rupture where you aim. Cast twice to link a pair, even across dimensions. Sneak-cast to collapse your ruptures.
ability.infinitygauntlet.spatial_rift.de: Tear a rift beneath your target. It drags in creatures and objects and spits them out high above.
ability.infinitygauntlet.blink.desc: Dissolve into spatial energy and reappear a short distance ahead.
Open orbiting portals that track enemies and fire bolts of folded space.
ability.infinitygauntlet.spatial_compres: A sphere that crushes space inward, pulling everything in before exploding outward.
Exchange the positions of two creatures, a creature and a marker, or yourself and an anchored target. Sneak-cast to place a marker.
Tear an enormous rupture into the sky above the battlefield, linked to one before you. Whatever enters falls from the sky.
Suspend a creature inside six rotating portal rings.
ability.infinitygauntlet.universal_telep: Carry yourself and nearby allies to your waypoint (sneak-cast to set it) or to where you aim.
advancement.infinitygauntlet.root.desc: Obtain an Infinity Gauntlet or an Infinity Stone
advancement.infinitygauntlet.tesseract.d: Install the Space Stone into a gauntlet
advancement.infinitygauntlet.between_wor: Travel through a rupture into another dimension
message.infinitygauntlet.echo.no_history: Not enough recent movement to echo yet. Move around first.
message.infinitygauntlet.rewind.nothing: Nothing here has a recorded past to rewind.
message.infinitygauntlet.barrier.raised: Chronological barrier raised. Cast again to release what it holds.
ability.infinitygauntlet.time_freeze.des: Stop time around you. Creatures, projectiles and falling objects hang motionless, then resume exactly where they were.
ability.infinitygauntlet.time_slow.desc: Lay a field on the ground where time runs at a quarter of its speed for everything but you and your allies.
ability.infinitygauntlet.time_accelerati: Speed up your own time: faster movement, attacks and mining, trailing green afterimages.
ability.infinitygauntlet.temporal_bubble: A great sphere in which time almost stops. Arrows hang inside it; you stay free outside.
ability.infinitygauntlet.temporal_echo.d: An echo of you from a few seconds ago re-walks your steps and draws enemies onto itself.
ability.infinitygauntlet.rewind.desc: Play the aimed target's recorded movement backwards (or everything hostile nearby). Sneak-cast to rewind yourself. Only movement is rewound.
ability.infinitygauntlet.temporal_loop.d: Mark a spot with a time anomaly. Whoever enters it keeps getting snapped back to the moment they arrived.
ability.infinitygauntlet.chronological_b: Raise a clockwork shield that slows and suspends incoming projectiles. Cast again to send them all back.
ability.infinitygauntlet.time_fracture.d: Shatter the air into a pane of broken time that pulses nearby creatures into near-stillness, then implodes.
advancement.infinitygauntlet.eye_of_agam: Install the Time Stone into a gauntlet
advancement.infinitygauntlet.dormammu.de: Trap a creature in a Temporal Loop
ability.infinitygauntlet.remote_consciou: Mind + Space. Open a rupture over a creature and thread a neural link to your Consciousness Nexus, then operate it from the console.
advancement.infinitygauntlet.remote_cons: Link a creature to a Consciousness Nexus
message.infinitygauntlet.nexus.not_owner: This Nexus answers to someone else.
message.infinitygauntlet.nexus.none: Bind a Consciousness Nexus first (use it).
message.infinitygauntlet.nexus.missing: Your Consciousness Nexus is missing or not loaded.
message.infinitygauntlet.nexus.other_dim: The creature is in another dimension than your Nexus.
message.infinitygauntlet.nexus.too_far: Too far from your Nexus (max %s blocks).
message.infinitygauntlet.nexus.full: Your Nexus is already holding %s feeds.
message.infinitygauntlet.nexus.linked: %s linked to the Nexus (feed %s). Use the Nexus to take control.
message.infinitygauntlet.nexus.no_link: No creature is linked. Cast Remote Consciousness (Mind + Space) at one.
message.infinitygauntlet.nexus.extract_b: No room beside the Nexus for extraction.
hud.infinitygauntlet.remote.controls: WASD move · Mouse look · Space jump · Sneak leave console
Mind + Space. Tear reality open on a creature. Walk into the tear to reach the white observation chamber and manipulate it from the control panel. Cast again to seal the breach.
message.infinitygauntlet.breach.opened: Reality tears open around %s. Step into the tear.
message.infinitygauntlet.breach.collapse: The breach collapsed under its own weight.
message.infinitygauntlet.breach.lost: Specimen lost. The tear is closing.
message.infinitygauntlet.breach.no_speci: There is no specimen to manipulate.
message.infinitygauntlet.breach.no_chamb: The observation chamber does not exist in this world.
subtitles.infinitygauntlet.power_planeta: A planet's worth of force gathers
ability.infinitygauntlet.power_beam.desc: Charge, then sweep a coiling beam of destruction. Kills are disintegrated in a slow-motion close-up.
ability.infinitygauntlet.cosmic_punch.de: Dash in and land one world-stopping blow. Wounded targets are executed.
ability.infinitygauntlet.groundbreaker.d: Leap and slam the ground: three rings of force split the earth and hurl enemies.
ability.infinitygauntlet.energy_nova.des: Rise into the air gathering power while time slows, then release it in a devastating sphere.
ability.infinitygauntlet.cosmic_artiller: Six orbs rise, lock onto enemies ahead and fall as meteors.
For ten seconds your blows carry shockwaves, sprinting tears the ground, and the overload vents at the end.
Call a singularity down: it lifts enemies helplessly into the air and crushes them into the earth.
Summon five orbs (cluster, chain, gravity, lance, shatter). Cast to fire one, sneak-cast to fire all.
ability.infinitygauntlet.planetary_force: Charge a planet's worth of force for three seconds and hurl it: a four-stage cataclysm.
message.infinitygauntlet.overload: Power Overload: your blows carry the stone.
message.infinitygauntlet.barrage_ready: Barrage ready: cast to fire, sneak-cast to unleash all five.
ability.infinitygauntlet.dimensional_era: Finisher: a rift swallows a weakened target and is crushed to a single point.
ability.infinitygauntlet.psychic_overloa: Finisher: lift a weakened target into a cage of psychic symbols and release it all in one pulse.
ability.infinitygauntlet.reality_rewrite: Finisher: freeze a weakened target, rewrite it through impossible states and shatter it into fragments of reality.
ability.infinitygauntlet.temporal_collap: Finisher: stop the scene, surround a weakened target with its past and future selves and collapse them into it.
ability.infinitygauntlet.soul_extraction: Finisher: tear the soul out of a weakened target and feed it to the Soul Stone.
message.infinitygauntlet.finisher.too_st: %s is too strong to finish (needs %s%% health or less).
message.infinitygauntlet.finisher.disabl: Finishers are disabled on this server.
